items.briefing:
Two stories need your attention today. Quest Apartment Hotels has confirmed a data breach affecting customer information, caused by a vulnerability in a third-party system — a reminder that our data can be exposed even when our own systems are secure. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) is warning that attackers are actively exploiting a weakness in N-able N-central software used by IT teams across Australia, so if your organisation uses this tool, check with your IT provider urgently. ASIC has also flagged a rise in AI-generated deepfake investment scams targeting Australians.

If you receive an unexpected email or message about your account details — especially following news of a breach — do not click any links. Go directly to the organisation's official website to check for updates and change your password if prompted.

featured.title: Quest Apartment Hotels confirms customer data breach linked to third-party vulnerability
